scope: asphalt-first finite internal research iteration; no independent road validation

texture.preprocessing: plane detrend; 400-500 cycles/m cosine lowpass; unit RMS; radial Hann PSD
texture.fold_scope: leave one original TRAIN file out among five/class; internal file CV only
texture.test_scope: 100 previously analyzed TEST members; one frozen benchmark, no retuning
texture.baseline_limit: historical H/band already selected with all five TRAIN files; fold moments refitted from remaining four

assumptions: all synthetic dimensions, texture RMS/H/band, seeds and coefficient searches are engineering hypotheses, not measured population distributions
native pothole outline uses known whole-frame labels and TLS support; angular sectors and depth blocks are transductive within-frame diagnostics
geometry and sensor factors are separated; engineering noise is not sensor calibration
